Name: Buildable Ginger Island Farm
Author: mouahrara
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/BuildableGingerIslandFarm/images/main.jpg[/img]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/BuildableGingerIslandFarm/images/scrolls/01.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New][b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b][/font].[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Run the game using [b]SMAPI[/b].[/size][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/BuildableGingerIslandFarm/images/scrolls/02.png[/img]

[size=3]After repairing the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Island_Farmhouse]Island Farmhouse[/url], you will be able to choose which farm you want to construct buildings on when opening either Robin's or the Wizard's construction menu. The Ginger Island farm now operates similarly to your main farm, allowing you to construct any type of building except cabins. This includes animal houses and special buildings such as obelisks, Junimo huts, etc.
By default, construction in the slime area is disabled. You can enable it from the mod configuration menu ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]). Note that to relocate buildings or farm animals from one farm to another, you will need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20606]Relocate Buildings And Farm Animals[/url] mod.[/size]

[size=3]See [url=https://github.com/mouahrara/BuildableGingerIslandFarm/assets/131559634/76425a65-c9ba-42f8-9578-adff7b8e0c8f]demo[/url].[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/BuildableGingerIslandFarm/images/scrolls/03.png[/img]

[size=3]Chinese (thanks to [b]txyyh[/b]), English, French, German (thanks to [b]Nana1873[/b]) and Portuguese (thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/200703680]NARCOAZAZAL[/url]) translations are included in the base mod, and contributions are welcome. To contribute, please submit a pull request on the [url=https://github.com/mouahrara/BuildableGingerIslandFarm/pulls]GitHub repository[/url].[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/BuildableGingerIslandFarm/images/scrolls/04.png[/img]

[size=3]Buildable Ginger Island Farm is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.0+ on Linux/Mac/Windows/Android, both single-player and multiplayer. It is also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15939]Lnh's Ginger Island Overhaul[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8742]Modest Maps Ginger Island Farm[/url].[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/BuildableGingerIslandFarm/images/scrolls/05.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3][b]Can I use this mod on an existing save?[/b][/size]
[size=3]Yes, no problem at all.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Can I uninstall this mod without any issues?[/b][/size]
[size=3]Yes, as long as you follow these steps: just before saving your game (by going to sleep), open the SMAPI console and enter the command [/size][font=monospace][size=4]bgif_removebuildings[/size][/font][size=3] to remove all buildings on the Ginger Island farm. After sleeping, exit the game and remove the mod from the [font=Courier New][b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b][/font] folder.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/BuildableGingerIslandFarm/images/scrolls/06.png[/img]
